headline: Google renames NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook
summary: Google rebrands NotebookLM as Gemini Notebook, previewing upcoming features.
details: Google announced today that NotebookLM is now called 'Gemini Notebook'. The rebranding comes with a preview of upcoming features that users can soon expect.
The company previously announced NotebookLM, an AI-powered note-taking app, in 2023. It is unclear what new features will be added to Gemini Notebook.

headline: Suno brings AI music to iMessage with 30-second tracks
summary: Generate music in chats with text or voice prompts
details: Suno has integrated its generative AI music into iMessage, allowing users to create 30-second music tracks directly from their chats. This feature is available in the latest version of the Suno iPhone app.
Users can access the music generation option by tapping the plus button in a chat and selecting Suno. They can use a text or voice prompt, and even choose a genre for the audio.
The recipient must also have the Suno app installed to hear the generated music.
